prompt: CSS display contents pseudo-elements box not generated
answer:
`display: contents` removes the element’s own box, but its child elements and pseudo-elements still generate boxes. Therefore, a `::before` or `::after` should still render, provided it has a `content` value; pseudo-elements require `content: ""` even for an empty box, and are not generated when `content` is absent or `none`.

Sources: [W3Cplus](https://w3cplus.medium.com/do-you-really-understand-css-display-fdfbe71875b8), [Facebook result](https://www.facebook.com/fb-answers/mdn-content-none-pseudo-element-not-generated/)
